# jets

**Tag**: web, devops

## 简介

Jets is a Serverless Deployment Service. Jets makes it easy to deploy and run your app on Serverless. It packages up your code and runs it on AWS Lambda. Jets can deploy Rails, Sinatra, and any Rack app.

## 官网

- 主页: https://rubyonjets.com
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/jets/6.0.6
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/jets
